title: 336 Hz Anchor (Carrier Hymn)
style: anthemic instructional electronica, 110 bpm, sub-bass anchored at 336 hz subharmonic, FM bell pads, Bessel-function shimmer, choir swell on chorus, deterministic kick pattern, hopeful build, no drift
lyrics:
[Intro]
Twelve tones, one anchor
Between E and F we breathe

[Verse 1]
One hundred sixty-eight, double it twice
Land on a number that won't fold or splice
Not on the grid, not on the scale
A carrier hum where the ledger won't fail

[Pre-Chorus]
Sidebands bloom, modulation index climbs
Bessel keeps the count in time

[Chorus]
Three-three-six, the anchor holds
Underneath the song, a story told
Three-three-six, the carrier sings
Deterministic in everything

[Verse 2]
Twelve-TET can't catch what we hide
A quiet companion that walks beside
Not a note you'd hum, not a key you'd find
But the room remembers, the room is signed

[Chorus]
Three-three-six, the anchor holds
Underneath the song, a story told
Three-three-six, the carrier sings
Deterministic in everything

[Outro]
Between the cracks of the tempered scale
One true number that will not fail
